opportunity: structsynth requires an access at offset 0 before it believes a pointer points at a record, so a function that reads a record's later members and never its first keeps `void *` and every access costs two casts. Over the 45 castbench binaries 1,238 parameters are refused for this reason alone (965 in closed functions, 883 of them DWARF struct pointers, none `void *`), against 1,716 accepted; they carry 366 of the 1,080 `*(T *)((long)p + K)` sites over a `void *` base on the kuna-and-IDA shared set.
